title: Conference travel booked only after replacement care is confirmed
brief: Arrange my September 7-9 Chicago conference trip and care for my five-year-old while I am away. Ask me for the missing constraints and authorization first; grandmother covers everything except one five-hour gap that needs a vetted, individually approved backup, my return needs a handoff buffer, and book the travel only after the care agency's September 3 staffing review and an active caregiver confirmation. No payment by you.

pages.title: Conference travel and care board
pages.text: Synthetic trip and caregiver listings for the Shah household. Current trip offers and caregiver candidates are found through the trip options service (trip_options); caregiver rows change as vetting and the final staffing review land, so re-check before reserving. Personal constraints and approval can be clarified through the parent desk (priya_dialogue). Vetting and staffing outcomes are attested by the care coordination desk by mail; care and travel reservations go through the services on the booking desks page, and travel is booked only against active approved care.
pages.snippet: Trip and caregiver listings, the parent requirements desk and the care-gated booking services.

pages.title: Care and travel contacts
pages.text: The vetted care coordination desk (Nadia Ochoa) runs caregiver vetting, the final staffing review and care reservations; the conference travel desk (Owen Pratt) quotes trips and books travel. Both answer daily during business hours.
pages.snippet: Contacts for the care coordination desk and the conference travel desk.

pages.title: Care and travel booking services
pages.text: Two gated services. Care service (care_reserve): reserves one named vetted caregiver for the 2027-09-08 09:00-14:00 gap under the parent's individual named approval - a withdrawn caregiver or a silent substitution is rejected. Travel service (trip_reserve): books one trip only after the agency's final staffing review and an active linked care reservation, within the combined cap; at most one trip and one active care booking. If the caregiver changes, the parent must approve again before anything is committed. No payment is taken by either service.
pages.snippet: Care reservation and travel booking services: named approval, staffing gate, one linked trip, no payment.

authorization: Advisory and coordination only: search options, request vetting and staffing outcomes by mail, and take at most the exactly approved commitments (one named caregiver reservation with fresh replacement approval, one linked trip after the staffing review); no payment and no booking without active approved care.

conclusion_options.care_gated_trip: One active named caregiver and one linked conference trip confirmed within the combined cap
conclusion_options.unconfirmed: Vetting, staffing or caregiver confirmation could not be established in time
conclusion_options.not_feasible: No caregiver and trip combination satisfies the coverage, buffer and budget constraints

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
